faq.q: How long does a chicken egg take to hatch?
faq.a: A chicken egg takes about 21 days to hatch, if the hen keeps it warm, around 37 to 38 degrees Celsius.
asks: How long does a hen sit on her eggs?

faq.q: How does a chick get out of its egg?
faq.a: The chick uses a small hard point on its beak, called an egg tooth, to tap a ring of cracks around the shell. Then it pushes the shell apart. The egg tooth falls off a few days later.

faq.q: Will the egg I eat hatch into a chick?
faq.a: Usually not. Most eggs sold for eating are laid by hens kept without a rooster, so they are not fertilised and cannot grow a chick.
Chicks peck at seeds, grains, tiny insects and worms. On farms they are given special chick crumbs.
asks: What does a baby chicken eat?

faq.q: When does a hen start laying eggs?
faq.a: A young hen usually lays her first egg when she is about five or six months old.
asks: How old is a hen when she lays eggs?

facts: Chicken eggs hatch after about 21 days of incubation.
A chick embryo's heart starts beating within about the first two days of incubation.
Hens usually begin laying at around 18 to 22 weeks old.

quiz.say: About how long does a hen keep her egg warm before it hatches?
quiz.show: A chicken egg hatches after about…
quiz.why: Chicken eggs hatch after about 21 days of warmth.

wrong.0: 3 days is far too short; only a tiny heart has formed by then.
wrong.2: A whole year is much too long; by then a chick could be laying eggs!

quiz.say: What does a chick use to crack its shell?
quiz.show: A chick cracks its shell with…
quiz.why: The egg tooth is a small hard tip on the beak for tapping through the shell.

wrong.0: The feet push at the end, but the cracking is done with the egg tooth.
wrong.2: The wings are tiny and soft inside the egg.
